{2} OrgTitle -> Title [bold]
{3} OrgTutorProgress -> Comment
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{6} OrgTutorDone -> DiagnosticOk
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{8} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgDone -> @comment.note
{9} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgHeadlineDone -> Comment
{10} OrgTutorTodo -> DiagnosticError
